summary: Verified the 3 /ai-wallet fixes AND uncovered + fixed a related 500 in /api/ai-wallet/ledger when the new activity-range chips pass a `since` ISO string. Backend: 4/4 pytest cases PASS on /api/ai-wallet/consumption (all-time, since-filter no-error, new test-debit increases total, positive delta rows excluded). Live admin call total_credits=5336.38 across 9 buckets — matches expected. Bug fix: /api/ai-wallet/ledger threw TypeError comparing datetime to str — fixed by coercing created_at to ISO via _ts_str. After fix the same query returns 200 with items. Frontend: pretty labels render in legend, filter chips, AND ledger rows; raw keys (deep_import_consolidate, url_import_detail, scrape_fetch, url_import_classify, ai_set_expectations) NOT leaking; old 'AI usage ·' label gone. activity-range-{7d,30d,90d,all} testIDs present + correctly fire /ai-wallet/ledger with/without `since`. ai-pie-range-7d still fires /ai-wallet/consumption?since=... independently — decoupling confirmed.

minor.issue: Returned 500 TypeError comparing datetime vs str in _in_range — FIXED by normalising created_at to ISO before comparison (see /app/backend/routes/ai_wallet.py:50-62).

action_items: (Optional) Add a pytest case for /ai-wallet/ledger?since=<ISO> to lock in the datetime-vs-str fix; current suite focuses on /consumption.
critical_code_review_comments: Defensive `delta: {$lt: 0}` match-filter in my_wallet_consumption guards against any stray kind='debit' rows with delta>=0 — verified in test 1d.
labelForFeature snake_case→Title Case fallback is solid; unknown keys never leak as raw to the UI.

Pie ai-pie-range and activity-range are now properly decoupled — confirmed via separate API requests in playwright capture (activity tap → /ai-wallet/ledger only; pie tap → /ai-wallet/consumption only).
Pre-existing bug in /ai-wallet/ledger _in_range was only exposed by the new activity-range chips (no prior caller passed `since`). Fix is type-safe and minimal.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed. Tests insert + cleanup ledger rows tagged note:'TEST_*' via fixture teardown; mongosh confirmed 0 leftover rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: If you need to revisit: login admin@test.com/AdminPass2026!. /api/ai-wallet/consumption returns total_credits=5336.38 across 9 buckets (until new spend lands). /api/ai-wallet/ledger?since=<ISO> now correctly returns 200 thanks to _ts_str coercion. labelForFeature lives in /app/frontend/src/utils/aiFeatureLabels.ts; consumed by AiConsumptionPie (labelMap prop) and ai-wallet.tsx (Recent activity rows + filter chips). TestIDs: activity-range-{7d,30d,90d,all} (independent) and ai-pie-range-{key}.
rca_of_issue: Root cause of 500: ai_wallet.get_ledger() returns some rows with created_at as a Python datetime object (older debits) while the new activity-range chip passes since as an ISO string from Date.now() — JS toISOString. Python refuses `datetime < str`. Fix: helper _ts_str() coerces datetime→ISO before comparison.
